description: This Java class 'TestlinkAPIXMLRPCClient' provides a client for reporting test case results to the TestLink API via XML-RPC. It includes configuration setup, a method to send test result reports, and a main method demonstrating usage.

classes.name: TestlinkAPIXMLRPCClient
classes.description: A Java class used to communicate with TestLink's API via XML-RPC by reporting test case results.

methods.name: testLinkReport
methods.description: Sends a test case result report to TestLink API with given test case ID, plan ID, and status.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method demonstrating how to call 'testLinkReport' with sample data.
